items.title: Broader markets outshine benchmarks, midcaps scale new peak
items.description: Amol Athawale, VP Technical Research, Kotak Securities believes that as long as Nifty trades below the 50-day SMA of 23,700 and for Sensex 75300, the weak sentiment is likely to continue. On the downside, the market could slip to 23,300-23,200/74100-73800.
